summary: Avalon Holdings filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into a Change in Terms Agreement dated July 28, 2026 with Wesbanco Bank (formerly Premier Bank), amending its September 24, 2025 Business Loan and Promissory Note Agreements. The amendment extends the line of credit maturity from July 31, 2027 to July 31, 2028; $3.2 million was drawn as of July 28, 2026. No pricing, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch borrower liquidity and any further extensions given the modest drawn balance.
